advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 24/27 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.626 over 27 corners (25 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 1.00 / R 1.00; 1/2 stops locked both

advice.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 2 stops (1 both-axle, 1 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.47) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
